appearance.subtle: Their pupils are a little too wide for the light in here.
appearance.obvious: Their pupils are blown open, black and wet, and they keep turning away from the lamps.
appearance.extreme: Their eyes are almost entirely pupil. They flinch from every light source in the room and squint at you like you are a window.

description: Your pupils have stopped closing all the way. The dark got easier. Everything else got worse.
name: Photophobia
